en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4306 - Aban narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), regarding a man who said: "I am obligated to offer a camel," but did not specify where it should be slaughtered.
Imam (as) said: "The slaughtering is to be done at Mina, and it should be distributed among the needy."
